# Connecting CompanyCam to HubSpot

Learn what HubSpot is and how to connect it to CompanyCam so that new Deals and Contacts automatically create Projects.

Updated over 3 weeks ago

Table of contents

[Connecting HubSpot](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/15425064-connecting-companycam-to-hubspot#h_2fa2efe13f)[FAQs](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/15425064-connecting-companycam-to-hubspot#h_403cdf781f)

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2463804574/78ef5c5984454c8e178efd6270ea/file-gBPmop2pvU.png?expires=1794209400&signature=945fb13b043b78d9ad2bf693bc5a42a20e8f009882909fe3cbc2a7fe7bce3214&req=diQhFcF%2BmYRYXfMW1HO4zRuKYO35qAKF48uw%2BOMGPWEmUPVSueGXMvc0ldXx%0A79AZcqAXKQaJiDXiOFQ%3D%0A)

HubSpot is a CRM for managing your marketing, sales, and customer records in one place. Connect it to CompanyCam, and every new Deal or Contact can spin up a matching Project automatically, so your job-site documentation lives right alongside the customer record. This article covers connecting the two. For how the sync works once you're set up, see [Using the CompanyCam + HubSpot Integration.](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/15424828-using-the-companycam-hubspot-integration)

This feature is only available on the web app.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2463805249/c1ba19c93ac7ad8c4e3beed39410/WhatSyncs_HubSpot.png?expires=1794209400&signature=45ba4842f428c09eab386c3282e83bf478c59fbb6e7f40e6587f6030ad957142&req=diQhFcF%2BmINbUPMW1HO4zWfDPnO%2Bp%2F0d06FZTMAO9daHqVG5g8Lea16a52Ot%0AFfM%2BI7xNGbzwQQTObiE%3D%0A)

* * *

## Connecting HubSpot

You'll need an active CompanyCam account and a HubSpot account to connect the two.

Note: You need [Admin](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14010242-user-permission-roles-explained) permissions in both CompanyCam and HubSpot to set up this integration.

1. Log in to CompanyCam > Click [App Marketplace](https://app.companycam.com/integrations) (Under **Integrations** in the left-hand navigation menu).

2. Find the **HubSpot** card and click **Connect**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2559376429/38423997791daf106455d5a5c390/HubSpot+Connet.png?expires=1794209400&signature=6d3b2f9ddae6c1b8f3f159ef59407c42df07c29e33a0b258e8844889978a7941&req=diUiH8p5m4VdUPMW1HO4zQLeqiI9IU0kDKVjWBbY68yqiRdwv919x2FM88vM%0AQrSF%0A)

3. In the pop-up, choose what creates a new Project: **Deals** or **Contacts**. Most teams pick Deals, since they track a job through a pipeline stage. Click **Save**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2559377041/14bfabb71b757daddb2ce56c31b6/HubSpot+Select+Deals.png?expires=1794209400&signature=0d58162d4e426f347dbcacc33ef3db64988103995d6653afeb8e97fceae016dc&req=diUiH8p5moFbWPMW1HO4zaHku7o%2BuE%2Bzzo2K78LRA6BRMr0xTUj9aPYheW2a%0A9qal%0A)

4. Sign in to HubSpot, or create an account, when the HubSpot window opens.

5. Pick the HubSpot account you want to connect, then click **Choose Account**.

6. Click **Connect App**. HubSpot sends you back to CompanyCam.

7. Optionally, use the dropdown to pick the exact **Deal stage** or **Contact lifecycle stage** that should create a Project. Leave it blank, and every new Deal or Contact creates one, no matter the stage.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2740536719/08a6e0625667465b656fba3d7abb/HubSpot+Optional.png?expires=1794209400&signature=b5f05a5d004da2816adc5caed1ab131be38b680e93caf56770d332576d74ece9&req=dicjFsx9m4ZeUPMW1HO4zfeW07ZuP6RVDMcMqolMaxR6I6x%2FTcnQhxshOEaR%0AGKbW%0A)

8. Click **Save**.


Note: CompanyCam connects to one HubSpot account at a time.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2559378462/41597201246146f4767f73ff1f90/HubSpot+Disconnect.png?expires=1794209400&signature=9ebceef1abd312818cf347a5598f5cbd89b23d19ebff7bf0dbedb5924d421b66&req=diUiH8p5lYVZW%2FMW1HO4zSg0RE6lX%2Bd4tfKdvisG4DJCaN8BLAkRDn38i%2FII%0AIlPOd%2B35uoZVyXOOd%2B8%3D%0A)

Once you're connected, head to [Using the CompanyCam + HubSpot Integration](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/15424828-using-the-companycam-hubspot-integration) to see how Projects, Files, and Checklists sync.

# FAQs

### Can I connect more than one HubSpot account?

CompanyCam connects to one HubSpot account at a time.

### Can I set up the integration on mobile?

Integrations can only be set up on the web app, not in the mobile app.

### Do I need a HubSpot account to connect with CompanyCam?

A HubSpot account is required to connect. You can sign in to an existing one or create a new one during setup.
